current_task: Electrical contest: V2.3 car-aircraft integration and scoring readiness
archive_note: The July L298N wheel-direction task is retained below as historical evidence and is not a current decision source.

archived_tasks.summary: Calibrate physical wheel direction against the staged L298N PWM test.
archived_tasks.known_good: Replacement L298N moved all four wheels; RR software direction was confirmed reversed; LF/RF/LR direction rows remained partial.

known_good.protocol_implementation: V2.3 parser and car-side 0x80/0x81/0x82/0x83/0x84/0x85 handling are present. Each 0x81 is now held until three successful current-calibration 0x80 CAR_POSE frames have been handed to UART5, and air ACK input is buffered by UART5 RXNE IRQ.
known_good.button_mapping: PG12 maintenance reset, PG13 task 1 start/second-press emergency stop, PG9 task 2 start/second-press emergency stop.
known_good.local_motion_authority: Gray line, direct JY901 yaw, and encoder distance start and run the car without radar or Pi.
known_good.radar_pi_fallback_policy: PG13/PG9 local motion never waits for radar, Pi, or CalibrationId. A fresh raw Pi pose plus valid MCU-local calibration can establish 0x81 coordination later; a missing pose may not be replaced with a fabricated CalibrationId.
known_good.car_pose_transmit_geometry: The raw Pi/radar pose remains internal. Only outgoing LoRa CAR_POSE uses X_lora = -(X_pi - 13 cm) + DeltaX, Y_lora = -Y_pi + DeltaY, and yaw_lora = yaw_pi; Pi must not apply the center offset, mirror, or Delta.
known_good.watchdog_policy: A moving lap retains the 90 s scoring watchdog. A separate 20 s encoder-no-progress watchdog stops a jammed or non-propelling vehicle.
known_good.calibration_path: Ground 0x83 is committed to MCU RAM and directly ACKed in the next car slot. A stopped-car request with a new sequence may replace the previous complete raw-pose Delta; duplicate Src+Type+Seq requests are ACK-deduplicated for 5 seconds. PG12 locally clears calibration and emits three 0x85 frames.
known_good.strict_v23_compliance_status: The one-way Pi-to-MCU local-calibration path is a compatibility field-test path. It does not prove the DOCX Pi 0x83/0x85 ACK transaction or platform-center scoring geometry, so it must not be marked as a strict scoring pass.
known_good.build_status: LineFollowMissionDebug builds successfully with MCU-local calibration, task 0x80 x3 -> 0x81 x3 preamble enforcement, UART5 RXNE ACK buffering, and a task-2-only 55% PWM ceiling. On 2026-08-01, J-Link SWD at 50 kHz connected to STM32F103ZE at 3.30 V, programmed and compare-verified every image section, reset and started the MCU; COM13 P returned a healthy IDLE status at t_ms=25226.
known_good.field_joint_test_status: User reports the car-aircraft joint test has succeeded and the system is ready for controlled parameter tuning. No per-frame air-side evidence from that run is stored in this repository, so preserve the next run's logs before making tuning claims.

external_blockers: Pi sends raw pose one-way only; its deployment and live pose freshness remain external hardware evidence, while calibration ownership is MCU-local.
The published V2.3 Pi calibration/ACK transaction and physical platform-center proof are not closed by the one-way compatibility path.
Flight-control STM32, air ESP32/LoRa forwarding, payload handling, and ground-station UI source are not in this repository.
No field evidence yet proves 10 Hz CAR_POSE, 2 Hz FLIGHT_TELEMETRY, task ACK/retry, or the scored physical flight stages.
